name: Default
shortDescription: Archive extractor for Sonarr, Radarr, Lidarr, Readarr and watch folders that unpacks completed downloads for import, with a web UI for queue, history and settings.

alerts.message: Log in as admin with the generated UI_PASSWORD from the environment; while that variable is set the password cannot be changed in the UI. Unpackerr only finds archives that sit in its downloads volume at the same /downloads path your Starr apps report, and it needs the URL and API key of each Starr app.
